newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures tradeless for fourth day.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures tradeless for fourth day.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat continued tradeless for a fourth successive day on Friday, leaving the market with only three lots traded over the week.

Ed Scamps of Elders Risk Management said the Australian Wheat Board's (AWB) pool price was creating a market floor. The AWB unexpectedly raised its pool price by A$2.00 a tonne to A$195.00 a tonne for Australian Standard White on Monday.
"It's not a very volatile market. You really need that volatility to get speculators in there," Scamps said. Growers were not interested in trading until crops were in, he said.
